senses.gloss: (cmp. חסל) to peel, scrape, to polish, glaze, harden (steel).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 6:10">Tosef. Shebi. VI, 10</cite>; Y. ib. VIII, 38ᵇ bot. <he>אין חוֹסְמִין וכ׳</he> you must not use it for glazing stoves or ranges.
Tosef. Bets. III, 16 כדי לחוֹסְמָן for the purpose of glazing them; Bets. 34ᵃ לחַסְּמָן (Pi.).—Y. M. Kat. I, end, 81ᵃ, v. infra.—[Tosef. Dem. IV, 12 משיחסום, read: משיתנם?]

senses.gloss: <cite ref="H01398">same</cite>. Bets. l. c., v. supra. Ib. <he>מפני שצריך לחַסְּמָן</he> because it is necessary to glaze the tiles (by heating them).
to be glazed. Y. M. Kat. I, end, 81ᵃ [read:] ואין מפיגין אותן בצונן כדי שיִתְחַסְּמוּ nor must you cool them off suddenly in order that they may be glazed (hardened). V. חִיסּוּם.
